market_name: Will 7 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the 7-cut probability move is corroborated by moves in fed funds futures and 2y yields; confirm it's not a thin-market fluke.
time_plan.1h: Re-check TLT vs 10y yield direction and whether any macro headline (jobs, CPI, crisis) explains the dovish repricing.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether the move persists or mean-reverts; look at 2s10s curve steepening as confirmation of easing bets.
time_plan.6h: Compare against equity and gold behavior to distinguish 'recession fear' vs 'benign disinflation' regime.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether Treasury rally held into window close and whether prediction-market signal led or lagged futures.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 7 cuts (175bps of easing) in 2026 signals a dramatically more dovish rate path than currently priced — usually driven by a growth scare or shock. Front-end and long-end yields would fall, pushing long-duration Treasury prices up. TLT is the most liquid, high-duration proxy and moves inversely to yields.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm dollar (DXY) is softening and real yields falling alongside the dovish repricing.
time_plan.1h: Check whether gold move is broad (spot, futures) or ETF-specific noise.
time_plan.2h: Look for risk-off cross-confirmation (VIX, equity weakness) supporting a crisis-driven easing narrative.
time_plan.6h: Reassess dollar trajectory and whether gold rally is sustained.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net move vs baseline and whether the prediction-market signal preceded the gold/USD move.

predictions.reasoning: An abrupt jump in expectations for aggressive 2026 Fed easing implies lower real yields and a weaker dollar, both bullish for gold. Gold is a liquid, non-yielding asset that benefits when rate-cut expectations surge, especially if driven by risk-off or crisis dynamics (consistent with the 'military_conflict' tag).

evidence_used: Market question asks about an extreme 7-cut (175bps) 2026 easing scenario, far more dovish than typical baseline pricing
A spike in this probability would coincide with a large dovish repricing of the Fed path
Standard macro transmission: dovish repricing lowers yields (bond prices up), weakens USD, supports gold
Liquid proxies TLT and GLD are the cleanest expressions of a lower-rate-path shock
uncertainty_notes: Prediction markets on Fed cuts are thin and can move on low volume; a probability jump may not reflect real information
7 cuts is a tail scenario; small absolute probability changes may carry little asset-price signal
If the dovish shift is driven by a growth/crisis shock, equities and even risk assets could fall, complicating the read
The 700bps tradable threshold is very unlikely to be met in a 12h window for these liquid instruments absent an outright crisis

llm_justification.summary: The market prices the tail probability of 7 Fed rate cuts in 2026, an unusually dovish easing path. A sharp rise in that probability would signal expectations of aggressive Fed easing — typically from a growth scare or shock — which transmits to lower yields (long Treasuries up) and a weaker dollar with lower real yields (gold up). Both mappings are plausible but modest in a 12h window and well below the 700bps tradable bar, so we treat this as low-confidence research signal rather than an actionable trade.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine dovish repricing rather than thin-market noise
Standard rate transmission holds: dovish path => lower yields, weaker USD, higher gold
The shift is large enough to move liquid proxies at all within 12h
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is illiquid noise and no real information leaked
The information is already public (e.g., after a known dovish data print or FOMC), so assets already moved
If easing expectations rise due to a crisis, equities fall and the gold/bond relationship may decouple (risk-off scramble for USD could even lift the dollar)
TLT and GLD are only indirectly exposed to a 2026-specific cut count; front-end futures would be a purer proxy
Expected moves are far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so signal is non-actionable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
